exposure: Women who received prenatal education and had a vaginal delivery
Women who received prenatal education and had a caesarean delivery
Women who did not receive prenatal education and had a caesarean delivery
Women who did not receive prenatal education and had a vaginal delivery
cohort: Pregnant women expecting either a caesarean or vaginal delivery were recruited and grouped based on whether they received prenatal education.
finding: Prenatal education did not significantly affect pre-delivery salivary cortisol levels or HRV parameters in either vaginal or caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: HRV parameters were higher in women who had a vaginal delivery compared to those who had a caesarean delivery.
